MultiHead(Q, K, V) = Concat(head1, ..., headh)WO

In this formula, the projections are parameter matrices WQi ∈ Rdmodel×dk, WKi ∈ Rdmodel×dk, WV i ∈ Rdmodel×dv, and WOi ∈ Rhdv×dmodel.

Multi-head attention is used to counteract the effect of averaging attention-weighted positions, which reduces the effective resolution of the model.
